title: SMV — 30-Second Awareness Commercial
hook: There aren't enough dental assistants — and every practice feels it.
concept: A calm, confident 30-second commercial for the SMV website. Expert-explains register (not a testimonial). Speaks to practice owners; compliance and the influencer/partner invite are carried as on-screen supers and the end card so the spoken line stays tight. American male presenter/narrator, ~30-35.
emotional_arc: Pressure (staffing shortage) -> Clarity (train your own) -> Confidence (SMV makes it low-entry and structured) -> Ownership (keep the tuition) -> Brand.
beat_sheet: Hook: the assistant shortage every practice feels.
Reframe: the smartest fix is to train your own.
SMV: launch a school inside your practice -- curriculum, platforms, licensing support, low-entry subscription.
Payoff: steady pipeline + keep the tuition.
Brand close on the master line.

scenes.audio: There aren't enough dental assistants -- and every practice feels it.

scenes.visual: Instructor-led skill check: adult learners in clean navy scrubs, tray setup, chairside practice inside the practice.
scenes.audio: The smartest fix is to train your own.
scenes.notes: The turn from problem to solution.

scenes.visual: SMV reversed/white logo resolves on navy; quick cutaways of the student & instructor platforms, curriculum modules, launch documents. Gold + violet-magenta gradient accents.

music_direction: Understated, confident, modern underscore -- soft sustained pads with a light pulse. Never hype. Small lift at the SMV logo reveal (scene 3) and the brand close (scene 5).
visual_intention: Premium clinical education, not a generic course ad. Real operatories, sterilization, tray setup, chairside assisting, instructor-led skill checks. Navy/charcoal scrubs; gold or violet-magenta only as small accents. Navy #0B1B32 / ink #07111F dark panels, warm cream #F6F3EC canvases, Authority Gold #C7983D eyebrows/dividers, violet->magenta gradient (135deg #34147A -> #7046A2 -> #B11872 -> #A00F3D) for rules and the end card. White text on every dark background. Inter typography.
cta: Primary: Start Subscription Intake (practice owners). Secondary: dental creators, podcasters, consultants and educators -> partner with SMV and refer practice-owner audiences.
